name: tiffin-tracker
description: Tiffin Tracker PWA with native real-time cloud sync and Web Push notifications

scripts.test: node -c www/app.js && node -c www/sw.js && node -c www/updater.js
scripts.build:apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk' 'Tiffin-Tracker-v5.3.8.apk' -Force"
